N6.evidence: The sweep grace is renewed at the last possible launch and at return/abandonment, while the flock is held, rather than relying on constructor mtime. Both cancellation and unclean-result probes retained scratch and observed sweep_work()==0 immediately after closing ownership, even after artificially old staging/runtime mtimes. This is function-level lifecycle evidence, not a fresh process-death/systemd interleaving.
